title: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.33922v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schr\"odinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demons

translated_title: 基于变分Doob-Wasserstein流的种群动力学学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的无模拟框架，用于在黎曼Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）流形上学习不平衡种群动力学，该框架被称为变分Doob-Wasserstein流（VDWF），建立在非平衡平均场薛定谔桥（MFSB）理论之上。首先，通过独立学习配备数据依赖度量的几何模型，我们的模型能够捕获种群动力学的内在几何结构。此外，利用Doob的h-变换，所提出的方法结合边界信息以改进基于流的轨迹推断。对于不平衡传输，采用生长模型来学习动力学，同时在WFR空间中无需模拟地构建中间质量样本。此外，我们使用一致对数Sobolev不等式（LSI）分析了所提出框架的收敛速度。最后，我们在多个真实世界数据集上验证了所提出的方法，证明了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非平衡平均场薛定谔桥理论的新型无模拟框架——变分Doob-Wasserstein流（VDWF），通过数据依赖的几何模型、Doob's h-变换边界信息和生长模型，在WFR流形上高效学习不平衡种群动力学并给出收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), a novel simulation-free framework built on unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge theory that learns unbalanced population dynamics on the WFR manifold by capturing intrinsic geometry with data-dependent metrics, incorporating boundary information via Doob's h-transform, and employing a growth model with guaranteed convergence.
